Can be consumed by a [[Sentient weapon]].

Thear gives you a quest, [[The Essence of a Dragon]], and asks you to collect gems found in the [[Wilderness Adventure Area|Exploration Zones]]. The gems drop out of rare encounter treasure chests in these zones. Once you get gems and turn them in, you never need to repeat this process. As of [[Module 9]], you only need any three of these six gems. (Additional gems may be sold or fed to [[Sentient Weapon#Sentient Jewels|Sentient Jewel]]s.)[[Category:The Essence of a Dragon gems]]

* {{Item|Aussiredar's Gem}} (white) - [[Aussircaex's Valley]]
* {{Item|Iskaryte's Gem}} (blue) - [[Mount Reysalon]]
* {{Item|Omaekrix's Gem}} (blue) - [[Soami Gardens]]
* {{Item|Sventusk's Gem}} (white) - [[Ruins of Gianthold]]
* {{Item|Thadargix's Gem}} (black) - [[Sands of Menechtarun]]
* {{Item|Vuthesjing's Gem}} (black) - [[Orchard of the Macabre]]
